top_signals.title: Oil Extends Gain, Bonds Fall on Inflation Concerns: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Crude oil extended its rally and Asian bonds tracked Treasuries lower as higher energy prices fueled inflation concerns and strengthened bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike. Gold dropped.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
